name: Further electrical supplier disruption
impact_days: 3 to 9 per affected task, one shared event
trigger: No confirmed dispatch slot at next supplier review
mitigation: Reserve finishing slot, confirm dispatch evidence and maintain alternate logistics quote.

name: Integrated test requires repeat work
mitigation: Review entry criteria and diagnostic coverage before the test. Repeat testing remains mandatory after a failure.

name: Dyno booking conflict
impact_days: Calculated explicitly in the deterministic resource schedule
trigger: Two assignments request Dyno A on the same working day
mitigation: Protect one integrated slot and review the priority queue weekly.
simulation: resource constraint, not a stochastic event

name: Incomplete release evidence
impact_days: Release remains blocked until evidence and approvals are complete
trigger: Mandatory record lacks accepted status, reference or approver
mitigation: Review evidence register weekly and assign an owner for each missing item.
simulation: evidence gate, not assigned an invented probability
